assay: bulk total RNA-seq (TruSeq Stranded Total RNA, Ribo-Zero Gold), rat plantaris, NextSeq 500 PE100; Salmon + tximport gene-level counts (S2.4.p1, S2.5.p2)
sample_inclusion: 24 female rats, generation 19, 14 months old: HRT and LRT lines x {FO 14 d, non-overloaded control}, n = 6/group, separate animals (S2.2.p1, S2.3.p1)

factors.name: overload
factors.type: between-animal; FO limb from FO animals vs plantaris of separate control animals

primary_estimand: Transcriptome response of plantaris muscle to 14 days of functional overload (synergist-ablation mechanical loading, a resistance-type contractile stimulus) within each endurance-trainability line (FOinLRT, FOinHRT), and the line difference in that response (DELTA = FOinLRT - FOinHRT, a 2x2 interaction). The endurance training itself (8 weeks, ~12 weeks of age) was used only to phenotype/breed the lines and precedes the sampled period by ~1 year; there is no sedentary-vs-trained contrast in the sequenced samples.

planned_contrasts.name: DELTA
planned_contrasts.definition: (LRT FO - LRT CTRL) - (HRT FO - HRT CTRL)

blocking_or_covariance.status: not_required for animal (one sample per animal); RIN covariate in the paper model

matrix_scale: Salmon estimated counts summarised by tximport (non-integer) (S2.5.p2; GEO data_processing)
paper_method: edgeR TMM + limma-voom, linear model incl. RNA integrity (RIN) covariate; genes with median CPM < 0.5 over all 24 samples excluded (S2.5.p2)
paper_formula: not_reported explicitly; implied ~ group (4 cells) + RIN with contrasts FOinLRT, FOinHRT, DELTA

paper_threshold.effect_cutoff_original: fold change > 2 ('twofold or greater' in S3.5.p1)

reported_counts.DELTA: no DEG count reported; analysed by GSEA (224 GO BP differ, 96 up / 101 down magnitude, 27 direction; S3.6.p1)

enrichment.method: GSEA on limma moderated t, GO biological process, clusterProfiler, 10,000 permutations, size 25-500; FDR<0.05 and P<0.001 for display
